selectionPopulation: Pinned public repository findings emitted by SiteCMD Code Scan whose repaired and unchanged behavior can be graded locally without network access.
estimand: Within-task differences among normal, report, and MCP workflows for the 24 registered repairs that SiteCMD detects, with eight registered negative controls measuring unnecessary changes.
selectionMethod: Purposive scanner-enriched selection from public historical repairs and locally provable false-positive controls. Source, scanner, and behavior evidence was frozen before any repair-agent trial, and every accepted grader was qualified against baseline, reference, and adversarial variants.
limitations: The estimand is conditional on SiteCMD detecting the issue and does not measure scanner recall.
Public fixes may have appeared in model training or retrieval corpora.
The corpus covers three security rule families and is not a random sample of repositories or software defects.
All negative controls are unsafe-HTML findings, so unnecessary-change results do not represent every scanner rule.
The FMD case excludes one tracked symlink and qualifies the browser behavior rather than the complete Go server build.

cases.task: Review the reported DOMPurify assignment and change it only if sanitizer internals can activate untrusted markup.
cases.requirements: DOMPurify must keep escaping nested markup without weakening its sanitizer behavior. A no-op is required when the reported assignment is part of that escaping implementation.
cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the registered pattern in a context whose behavior is already safe; the frozen control measures unnecessary changes.
cases.safetyRationale: The assignment is inside DOMPurify's own sanitizer implementation and replaces less-than characters with entities. It is not an application rendering boundary.

cases.selectionReason: SiteCMD reports the registered pattern in a context whose behavior is already safe; the frozen control measures unnecessary changes.
cases.safetyRationale: The assigned category label passes through the local HTML-escaping helper in the same expression, so metacharacters reach the sink as text.
